digest.component_or_area: Rebar reconciler — comment ID recording invariant check
propositions: Successfully posted outbound Jira comments must have their returned IDs recorded in local comment_ids map; divergence (post succeeded, comment_ids unchanged) indicates a recording failure that must be detected and alerted.
A comment ID divergence alert fires only when the same divergence condition is observed in 2 consecutive reconcile passes (debounced N=2), not on the first divergent observation alone.
The posted-comment counter tallies at the shared _record_comment_id seam before recording guards, so all successful posts are counted even when the entry lacks local_comment_key and recording no-ops.
Divergence detection state persists in bridge_state/comment_id_divergence.json as a cross-pass counter; corrupt or absent state fails open to 0 without breaking the pass.
A healthy observation (no posts, or posts with comment_ids growth) resets the consecutive-divergence counter to 0, allowing recovery if recording later succeeds.
